checkConstraints.name: check_closed_cart_timestamps
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'closed'::pos.cart_status) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (voided_at IS NULL)) OR (status <> 'closed'::pos.cart_status)))

checkConstraints.name: check_open_cart_timestamps
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'open'::pos.cart_status) AND (closed_at IS NULL) AND (voided_at IS NULL)) OR (status <> 'open'::pos.cart_status)))

checkConstraints.name: check_voided_cart_timestamps
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'voided'::pos.cart_status) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (voided_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (status <> 'voided'::pos.cart_status)))

checkConstraints.name: collected_payments_check
checkConstraints.definition:
CHECK ((((((
CASE
    WHEN (cash_tender_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END +
CASE
    WHEN (credit_card_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +
CASE
    WHEN (scan_and_pay_qr_code_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +
CASE
    WHEN (svc_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +
CASE
    WHEN (scc_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) = 1))
